# package codegen

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/codegen"
```

Package codegen generates typed Go code from an EDS or DCF ([eds.File](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/eds#File)): index and sub-index constants for every object, a NewDictionary function that builds the object dictionary without parsing anything at run time, a typed local accessor over an [od.Dictionary](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/od#Dictionary) and a typed remote accessor over an SDO client.

The generated package declares

	const IndexDeviceType uint16 = 0x1000 // one per object
	const SubIdentityObjectVendorID uint8 = 0x01 // one per sub-object of an ARRAY or RECORD
	func Objects() []*od.Object
	func NewDictionary(node canopen.NodeID) (*od.Dictionary, error)
	type Local struct{ D *od.Dictionary }   // DeviceType() (uint32, error), SetDeviceType(uint32) error, ...
	type SDO interface { Upload(...); Download(...) }
	type Remote struct{ SDO SDO }           // DeviceType(ctx) (uint32, error), SetX(ctx, v) error, ...

Each sub-object gets the natural Go type of its data type: bool, int8..int64, uint8..uint64 (24-bit types as 32-bit and 40..56-bit as 64-bit Go types, range-checked on set), float32, float64, string for VISIBLE\_STRING and UNICODE\_STRING, \[]byte for OCTET\_STRING, DOMAIN and the TIME types. The remote accessor has getters for the readable and setters for the writable sub-objects only; the local accessor has both for every sub-object (local access bypasses access rights).

The output is deterministic (no timestamps, index order), gofmt'd and carries its provenance: the source name, the SHA-256 of the source and the generator version. It imports only the standard library and go-canopen's root and od packages.

## Constants

```go
const Version = "1"
```

Version identifies the generator in the provenance header. It changes when the generated code changes.

## Functions

### func Generate

```go
func Generate(f *eds.File, opts Options) ([]byte, error)
```

Generate returns the Go source for f. The file must validate without errors ([eds.File.Validate](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/eds#File.Validate)) and build a dictionary ([eds.File.Dictionary](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/eds#File.Dictionary)); limits with $NODEID are not supported (the generated objects do not depend on the node-ID except through node-ID-relative defaults).

### func Ident

```go
func Ident(name string) string
```

Ident derives an exported Go identifier from an object name: the ASCII letters and digits of each word, each word capitalised ("COB-ID used by RPDO" → "COBIDUsedByRPDO"), with "X" in front of a leading digit. It returns "" when the name has no ASCII letter or digit.

type Options struct {

Options control generation.
